name: Grok
summary: Assistant from SpaceXSI for chat, images, code, and live answers from the web and X.
description: Grok’s homepage on 21 October 2026 said: “Grok is an AI assistant built by SpaceXSI. Chat, create images, write code, and get real-time answers from the web and X.” grok.com/pricing returned 404 and x.ai/pricing returned 403, so no plan price is copied here.
